facts.fact: Mauritius Telecom's CEO says its data centre in Mauritius now hosts NVIDIA H200 GPUs.
facts.system: Mauritius Telecom data centre H200 GPUs

facts.fact: Mauritius Telecom says its sovereign MyTGPT, a local enterprise-grade equivalent of ChatGPT, is in use and now integrates with Microsoft 365, Gmail and Shopify.
Mauritius Telecom says NVIDIA B300 GPUs for its Mauritius data centre are due by the end of the year.
